Production backend remains 6184a859 (neither #683 nor #684 is deployed). Additive, migration-free correction to the DAILY REALIZED P&L currency resolution in analytics/portfolio.py (ADR-0120). DEFECT: when an account's currency could not be established (live balance read failed AND no fresh tenant-local snapshot AND blank account_currency -- the production norm), _account_realized_currency defaulted to USD (normalise_currency(None)==USD) and build_summary fed the realized path an observed_ccy that had already collapsed blank->USD, so a non-USD account's same-day native realized was summed as USD with basis='USD' (false completeness). FIX: _account_realized_currency resolves via resolve_position_currency (blank->UNKNOWN_CURRENCY, mirroring the open-position path); build_summary builds a separate unknown-PRESERVING realized_ccy map for the realized call ONLY (balance/equity/metrics keep observed_ccy -- byte-identical); daily_realized_pnl_detail excludes UNKNOWN_CURRENCY accounts with stable reason 'unknown_currency' (category currency_unconvertible), surfacing the native figure labelled UNKNOWN, so the aggregate is PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE, never summed as USD, never a false $0.00, never cross-tenant (map keyed by account id). No migration, no flag, no schema/DB change, no backfill, no snapshot fabrication, no broker/host contact. Out of scope (same root pattern, documented follow-up): account_net_pnl (LIFETIME net) and portfolio_metrics (lifetime performance); the single-account dashboard card uses the DailyPnlView NATIVE figure and is structurally immune to the sum-as-USD aggregate defect.
